_comment: Batch B3: the staged values re-sourced from the grab itself. bmak_chain.py joins the BmSDK layout names onto every cooked value (Research/BatmobileGrab/CHAIN.json, cross-checked 336/0 against OFFSETS.json), which showed three of Batch B2's four 'no member in BmAK' claims were false. Supersedes t5c_edits.json for these members; T-ST5's two withdrawn fleet-median values are replaced by BmAK's own 1.0/1.0.
source: T_PLAN.md section 4 Batch B3 + Working/Translation/T1_TRANSLATION.md sections 6/8/10
status: staged: values computed from CHAIN.json; rows stay `next` until their take passes (R4)

edits.behaviour: DriftCorrectionSteerSpeed 1.0 (RVehicleBatmobileBase) and DriftSteeringAssist/DriftSteeringBias absent -> false/0: BmAK's drift correction runs at the base steering rate with no assist gain (CHAIN.json)

edits.why: identity from the chain; declared out-of-domain (R3): shipped countersteer 1.5..20 (n=252), land 2..5, donor 2. Bridge is name-semantic (drift-correction steer speed)

edits.behaviour: SteeringSpeedReCentreMod 1.0 (RVehicleSimCar) - the chain's only other steering-rate modifier; kind-match, documented not proven (CHAIN.json)
edits.why: identity from the chain; declared out-of-domain (R3): shipped steer_in 1.2..10 (n=252), land 1.5..2, donor 1.5

edits.behaviour: min(FakeExtraSpeedMax 3500, FakeExtaSpeedAccel 600 x BoostDuration 2.0) = 1200 cu = 43.2 km/h on the project's cm/s convention (CAMERA.md: 3000 cu = 108 km/h); InfiniteBoost false (bit 29 clear in Default__RVehicleBatmobileBase); the 3500 ceiling is reachable only in BoostDurationDonut 6 s
edits.take: A2 airfield top-speed run, boost off then on: terminal speed rises while boosting, delta recorded
edits.why: computed from four BmAK members; in-domain 30..60 (n=145, med 40); above the +32.4 km/h torque-band bound; replaces Batch B2's donor 40

edits.behaviour: no grip or traction member anywhere: G1-1 named all 423 fields (OFFSETS.json) and bmak_chain.py --grep 'Grip|Traction' over the vehicle/sim chain returns none - BmAK boost is grip-neutral
edits.take: A9 0-100 with and without boost: boost improves 0-100 and there is no grip snap on engage
edits.why: identity from proven absence; declared out-of-domain (R3): shipped 1.2..2 (n=145), donor 2. Replaces Batch B2's donor 2.0
